recentItems.title: Vanessa Poonah on The Tactical Response Team Captain who died in the line of duty
recentItems.description:
The Tactical Response Team captain who died during a shootout with a suspect in Knysna last week has been described as a crime fighter par excellence. A memorial service is underway in Cape Town to honour Captain Zamani Mzayiya. The provincial police commissioner says he was a highly skilled and dedicated member with 24 years service.

recentItems.title: Western Cape Police Commissioner Sizakhele Dyantyi lauds fallen officer Zamani Mzayiya
recentItems.description:
Western Cape Police commissioner, Sizakhele Dyantyi has lauded  TRT captain, Zamani Mzayiya as a loyal policeman who dedicated his life to fight crime. A memorial service is currently underway in Cape Town for Mzayiya who was killed during a shootout between police and suspects in Knysna last week.  He was part of the deployment following a spate of fatal shootings including that of former Knysna mayor, Aubrey Tsengwa. Mziyiya was also part of the team deployed to Robertson in the Western Cape during a standoff between a heavily armed suspect who opened fire on police, last month.
